description: List the admin regions (US states / provinces) of a country, each with its city_count and postcode_count. This is how you discover valid state names for a US ZIP campaign: pick ONE state, then create_campaign with filter { mode: "regions", admin_regions: [state], include_postcodes: true }. A state's postcode_count is roughly how many Maps searches the ZIP run fans out into.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: list_regions
